revisions.title: Create your first product
revisions.summary: Choose New product, select what you are making, then build and save its formula.
revisions.body_markdown:
1. Choose **New product**.
2. Select the product type, such as a soap bar or body lotion.
3. If offered a choice, select the calculation method that matches your process.
4. Give the product a recognizable name.
5. Add ingredients and quantities in the workbench, then **Save**.

Continue with **Packaging**, **Costing**, **Composition & labeling**, and **Instructions & media** as needed.

The product card opens its workbench. **Product sheet** opens the saved product view.

### I chose the wrong calculation method

Create a separate product with the correct method. Product classification and calculation method are different choices.

revisions.title: Find or archive a product
revisions.summary: Search by name and check filters. Archived products are hidden from the Active list.
revisions.body_markdown:
### A product is missing

1. Check the search text.
2. Change **Status** to **All** or **Archived**.
3. Clear classification filters and search again.

### Keep the list tidy

Use the product card's actions menu to **archive** a product you no longer work on. Archiving keeps the record and its history.

To bring it back, select **Archived**, find the product, and choose restore from its actions menu.

Read the confirmation before permanent removal. Archive when you simply want to hide an old product from the active list.

revisions.title: Save a version or make a copy
revisions.summary: Save to continue the same product. Duplicate to develop a separate product independently.
revisions.body_markdown:
- **Save:** records your work on the current product. Leaving the page does not replace saving.
- **History:** lets you review saved workbench versions.
- **Duplicate:** creates a separate starting point from the product actions.

After duplicating, give the copy a clear name and review its formula and packaging. Later edits to the copy do not update the original.

### Editing controls are disabled

Check the formula lock and your workspace permissions. An authorized owner or workspace admin must unlock a locked formula before you can edit it.

revisions.title: Upload files and check their status
revisions.summary: Choose Upload files to add images or PDFs. Wait for processing to finish before using a new file elsewhere.
revisions.body_markdown:
1. Choose **Upload files**.
2. Review the selected files and start the upload.
3. Check the upload queue for file-specific errors.
4. Wait until processing finishes before selecting the file elsewhere.

**Uploading and processing are separate.** A finished upload can still show Processing while its preview is prepared.

### The file is not ready

Check its status first. If processing failed, use **Retry** when available. If it fails again, check the original file.

Avoid uploading repeated copies while processing is still running. If upload is unavailable, check the displayed library allowance.

revisions.title: Find and organize files
revisions.summary: Search and filter the library, then open a file to check its details, labels, and uses.
revisions.body_markdown:
- Give files descriptive names that you will recognize in a picker.
- Use labels to group related files without uploading copies.
- Filter by type, status, usage, or label to narrow a large library.

### A file is missing

Check the search text and clear filters. Check its processing status if it was just uploaded.

For images, inspect the preview. Where focal-point editing is available, choose the part to keep visible in cropped previews. This changes the framing, not the original subject.

revisions.title: Reuse or remove a file
revisions.summary: Reuse existing library files. Check their uses before deleting them from the library.
revisions.body_markdown:
### Use the same file again

Select it through the file picker. One library file can be attached to several supported records, including products, ingredients, and packaging items.

### Remove it from one record

Remove the attachment on that record. You do not need to delete the library file.

### Delete it from the library

1. Open the file and inspect its uses.
2. Read the deletion confirmation and its listed impact.
3. Delete only if you intend that impact on the records using it.

Library deletion depends on workspace permissions. Contact your workspace owner or admin if the action is unavailable.

revisions.title: Choose your interface language
revisions.summary: Choose your language under Preferences, then Save preferences. This changes your account preference.
revisions.body_markdown:
1. Open **Preferences**.
2. Choose the interface language.
3. Choose **Save preferences**.

This changes interface text. It does not translate names, notes, instructions, or other text you entered.

### Why is a help topic still in English?

Help uses a published translation when it matches the current English version. Otherwise it falls back to English.

Choose **Number format** separately if you prefer different decimal or grouping separators.

revisions.title: Choose your number format
revisions.summary: Number format changes decimal and grouping separators. It does not change quantities or measurement units.
revisions.body_markdown:
1. Open **Preferences**.
2. Choose the number format you want to use.
3. Choose **Save preferences**.

The same quantity may appear as **1,234.56** or **1 234,56**. Follow the separators shown by the interface when entering values.

### I want grams instead of ounces

Number format does not convert units. Convert the individual formula using its supported mass units.

The workspace measurement system sets the starting unit for new formulas. It is separate from your personal number format.

revisions.title: Set shared workspace defaults
revisions.summary: Workspace name, default currency, and measurement system are shared. Only the workspace owner can change them.
revisions.body_markdown:
1. Open the **Workspace** tab and check the selected workspace.
2. Update the name, default currency, or measurement system.
3. Choose **Save workspace settings**.

- **Default currency:** used for workspace costing and pricing.
- **Metric:** starts new formulas in metric units; ingredient prices use kilograms.
- **US customary:** uses ounces and pounds; ingredient prices use pounds.

You can still convert an individual formula between g, kg, oz, and lb.

### I cannot edit these settings

Check whether you are the workspace owner. Language and number format are personal preferences and are saved separately.

Correct supplier prices on their own records, with the correct currency. Do not change the workspace currency to fix one price.

Production scheduling and numbering have separate settings in the Production bench.
